messages.subject: Project Juniper - LSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (v2). Principal changes: payment terms to 45 days / EOM following; liability cap to 150% (£5.864m Yr1); deletion of the £100/tonne goods sub-limit; convenience termination to 6 months from end of Year 2; indexation cap to 3%. Most other points are minor. Happy to take a call once you've digested.

Jonathan

messages.plaintextBody:
Team - Castle & Vane's v2 is in. As expected: cap up to 150%, goods sub-limit gone, 6-month convenience notice, indexation down to 3%. I'll draft an advice note for Gordon/Lesley with our recommended counters and circulate before I reply. Aiming to get our v3 back to them for a 6 May call.

James
